minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Room 280A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  The Beverly Hills City Council Liaison /
  Finance and Audit Committee

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Monday, January 29, 2024
  4:08 PM
MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  January 29, 2024 / 4:08 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian A. Gold M.D., Vice Mayor Lester Friedman, City Treasurer
  Howard Fisher, Assistant City Manager Ryan Gohlich, Director of Finance
  Jeff Muir, Assistant Director of Finance Tatiana Szerwinski, Executive
  Assistant Vanessa Catullo, Crowe Audit Partner Jeff Jensen, and Crowe
  Audit Senior Manager Joseph Widjaja

  1) PUBLIC COMMENT

  Members of the public were given the opportunity to directly address the Committee on
  any item listed on the agenda.
  None.

  2) AUDITOR DISCUSSION WITH AUDIT COMMITTEE

  Crowe Audit Partner, Jeff Jensen provided an overview of the Fiscal Year 2022-23 audit
  process with highlights below:

  Fiscal Year 2023 Auditor’s Report
  • Unmodified opinion: Financial statements are presented fairly, in all material
  respects.
  • The auditors did not note:
  o Significant accounting policies in controversial or emerging areas.
  o Significant unusual transactions.
  o Significant difficulties encountered during the audit.
  o Disagreements with management.
  o Consultations with other accountants.
  o Significant related party findings and issues.
  o Independence matters.

  GANN AUP Report
  Agreed-upon Procedures Report on Appropriations Limit to assist management in
  determining compliance with Section 1.5 of Article XIIIB of the California Constitution
  (GANN Limit).
   CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Room 280A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  The Beverly Hills City Council Liaison /
  Finance and Audit Committee

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Monday, January 29, 2024
  4:08 PM
  No instances of non-compliance or other matters noted.

  GASB Implementations: Statement No. 96, Subscription-Based Information Technology
  Arrangements, for fiscal years beginning July 1, 2022.

  Corrected Misstatements: The auditors did not note any material corrected
  misstatements that were brought to the attention of management as a result of their
  audit procedures.

  Uncorrected Misstatements: The auditors did not note any material uncorrected
  misstatements that were brought to the attention of management as a result of their
  audit procedures.

3) PRESENTATION AND REVIEW OF JUNE 30, 2023 ANNUAL FINANCIAL AUDIT AND
  ANNUAL COMPREHENSIVE FINANCIAL REPORT (ACFR)
  ACFRFY23FINAL.pdf (beverlyhills.org)

  Director of Finance, Jeff S. Muir, provided an overview of the City’s financial statements
  for Fiscal Year 2022-23, which included:
  • Notice of the City’s 35th consecutive award by GFOA for Excellence in Financial
  Reporting for Fiscal Year 2021-22, with the current year’s statements submitted
  in December 2023 for review.
  • A review of Management’s Discussion and Analysis (MD&A), Statement of Net
  Position, Statement of Activities, reviews of Business-Type Activities,
  Governmental Funds, the General Fund and reserves, and Long-Term Liabilities.

4) ADJOURNMENT

  Date / Time: January 29, 2024 / 4:42 PM
